name: The Parasol Festival
source:
Anise Quintilli, the protagonist of the game is an apprentice merchant of the Appian Guild and has a crush on her childhood friend Lynae. However, Anise was never able to convey her feelings because Lynae had left her behind to become a traveling merchant.
Now that Lynae has returned for The Parasol Festival, and Anise has three days to spend with her... what will happen on those three days?
Will she be able to convey her feelings...?
